reason: The tool call omits the Hiking Boots item id (8277474082) from item_ids and new_item_ids, meaning modify_pending_order_items would be called with only the three removed items and no replacement items, which triggered the prior 'number of items to be exchanged should match' error. Per policy, this action can only be called once per order and requires all items to be modified to be collected first with correct same-position replacements of the same product type; there is no policy-supported way to simply drop three items without providing matching new_item_ids, and doing so would either fail or produce an incorrect one-time irreversible modification. The assistant's own restated plan to the user does not resolve this structural mismatch in the actual arguments being submitted.
policy_references: Exchange or modify order tools can only be called once per order. Be sure that all items to be changed are collected into a list before making the tool call!!!
For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'.
